* QuestieDB: https://github.com/Questie/QuestieDB/tree/1f538335cfbb240c14a97c340f48c555fdc8a52b — preserve the accompanying QuestieDB-LICENSE.md historic licensing notice and GPL-3.0.md.
* CMaNGOS Classic-DB: https://github.com/cmangos/classic-db/tree/77b848e78fe31bdd0c5562922be49a4e8e5e79df — GPL-2.0-or-later; see ClassicDB-LICENSE.md.
